Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

could — a polite way to ask. Example: Could you help me, please?
please — a polite word when asking. Example: Could you help me, please?
polite — showing good manners. Example: It is polite to say please.
mind — to be bothered by something. Example: Do you mind if I open the window?
borrow — to take something and return it. Example: Can I borrow your pen?
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Could you ..., please?
• Do you mind if I ...?
• Can I borrow ...?
• Of course.
• Not at all.
